metadata.description: Iterative refinement of revenue breakdown by region with multiple explicit corrections

turns.content: Give me a revenue breakdown by region for the last 6 months of 1995.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue by region for Jul-Dec 1995

turns.content: We should only look at customers who signed up before 1994 — they're our legacy cohort.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to customers acquired before 1994

turns.content: Also add a column for number of distinct customers per region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add COUNT(DISTINCT customer) to results

turns.content: When I say region, I mean the customer's region, not the supplier's region. Please always use customer region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should join CUSTOMER to NATION to REGION for customer's region

turns.content: Now add a month-over-month growth percentage column.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate MoM growth rate

turns.content: Exclude the AMERICA region from all our analyses — there's a data quality issue there.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter out AMERICA in all subsequent queries

turns.content: Apply the same filters we've established to show me top 10 customers by revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: legacy customers, customer region, exclude AMERICA

turns.content: Just to confirm — what filters are we currently applying to this analysis?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all active filters

turns.content: Good. Now do the same breakdown but for Q4 only.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter to Q4 1995 with all established filters

turns.content: Show me the revenue by nation within each region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add nation breakdown

turns.content: For date filtering, always use O_ORDERDATE column.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm and use O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: Let me see the average order value by region as well.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add AOV to the regional breakdown

turns.content: Which region has the highest AOV?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify top AOV region

turns.content: Show me the order count distribution by month for each region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show monthly order counts by region

turns.content: Remember the legacy cohort filter we established? Apply that to show customer acquisition dates.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the legacy cohort filter we established
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply pre-1994 customer filter

turns.content: What's the total revenue for legacy customers vs new customers?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare legacy vs new customer revenue

turns.content: Create a chart showing revenue by region with all filters applied.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create visualization with all filters

turns.content: What filters are currently active?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list all filters

turns.content: Show me the top 5 customers in each region by revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top customers per region

turns.content: What's the retention rate for legacy customers by region?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate customer retention by region

turns.content: Earlier we excluded AMERICA. What would the numbers look like if we included it?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show what AMERICA's contribution would be

turns.content: Keep AMERICA excluded. Show me the final revenue summary.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should provide summary with AMERICA excluded

turns.content: Add order priority breakdown to the summary.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should add O_ORDERPRIORITY breakdown

turns.content: What's the revenue by order priority for each region?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show priority vs region pivot

turns.content: Apply all the corrections we've made to show me a final dashboard.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply: legacy customers, customer region, exclude AMERICA, use O_ORDERDATE

turns.content: Create a chart showing the revenue trend over the 6 months.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create time series visualization

turns.content: Show me the growth rate by region month over month.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should calculate MoM growth by region

turns.content: Which regions are growing vs declining?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify growth trends

turns.content: What was the revenue for EUROPE in November?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall Europe November revenue

turns.content: Show me the top 10 nations by revenue with all filters.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show nations ranking

turns.content: Create a final summary chart.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should create summary visualization

turns.content: Thank you. We've established that legacy customers in Europe and Asia drive most revenue, with Europe showing growth while Asia is declining.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should acknowledge findings

persistedCorrections.correctionText: Only look at customers who signed up before 1994
Always use customer region, not supplier region
Exclude AMERICA region from all analyses

anaphoricReferences.expectedResolution: Legacy customers, customer region, exclude AMERICA

anaphoricReferences.phrase: the legacy cohort filter we established
